build_source: Built from the working tree on top of the base commit; the commit that adds this record contains exactly those sources.
change: Controller X must be held for 0.9 s to save and stop a running server, confirm instance deletion, or confirm an uninstall; a bottom progress pill shows the hold, and releasing, moving or pressing another button cancels it. Mouse and keyboard confirmation stay immediate. While hosting or in server setup, non-current tabs are dimmed and a HOSTING pill appears beside the brand. Success and error results appear as toasts in the bottom message slot (3.5 s and 7 s). Byte downloads and server setup show smoothed speed and time left. The browser upload area accepts drag and drop and shows a row with progress and result for each file.
checks: All 21 standard and 14 native host checks passed.
test_launcher_web.py adds speed and time-left formatting and the hosted footer and status text for running and stopped servers.
Host Vulkan rendered the hold indicator, error toast, dimmed tabs and HOSTING pill on the Servers page.
The browser upload area was checked with two dropped files at phone width; the page script passes a syntax check.
Signed SELF integrity, ZIP checksum and the independent package audit passed for the recorded package.
pending_console: Physical PS5: hold timing and cancellation for save-and-stop, delete and uninstall; toast readability and timing; dimmed tabs and HOSTING pill on a TV; download speed during a real install; drag and drop from a PC browser. The 307 browser server control checks also remain pending.
release_store: Local test candidate only. No release, prerelease or Store action until the user confirms this exact build works on a physical PS5.
